title: Petra - Ruins Structure ✅
description: Petra is an ancient desert city in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by the rock-carved wonders of Jordan, featuring monumental facades and hidden passages.
body:
![Petra front](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8rE3l6uj/images/f6c4893a665cb8226a3e01b71f26e6725208e778.png)

Step into the past and uncover the lost city of Petra with the **Petra Mod**! This mod introduces stunning **rock-carved facades and ancient desert ruins** into Minecraft, appearing in mesa and desert biomes as monumental structures hidden within cliffs. Each site captures the grandeur and mystery of the real-world wonder, filling your world with **history, exploration, and secret treasures**.

![Petra fish eye](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8rE3l6uj/images/3f1720c66793b0861fec14038455e0e8262fc113.png)

Perfect for players who enjoy **exploration, world-building, and discovering landmarks with cultural and historical inspiration**, the Petra ruins serve as unique points of interest to enrich your Minecraft adventures. Wander through the carved facades, admire the monumental desert architecture, and let your imagination journey into the mysteries of an ancient civilization hidden in stone.

![Petra river](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8rE3l6uj/images/39518a8a08de182bdf2a1ee9c0a220cad26d80a6.png)

Whether you're a **solo explorer or part of a multiplayer server**, these ruins bring **atmospheric depth, realism, and storytelling** potential to your world. Petra is more than a monument—it’s an invitation to uncover the wonders of ancient civilizations while enhancing the desert beauty of your Minecraft landscapes.
